title: Kernel Density Estimation

plan.insight: A KDE puts a small bump on every sample and adds them up; bandwidth decides between spiky and over-smoothed.
plan.user_changes: bandwidth, drag samples along the axis, click to add samples, new sample

init: return { pts: range(30).map((i) => round(clamp(i % 3 ? randn(-1.5, 0.7) : randn(1.8, 0.5), -4, 4), 2)) };

components.label: New sample
components.onClick: return { pts: range(30).map((i) => round(clamp(i % 3 ? randn(-1.5, 0.7) : randn(1.8, 0.5), -4, 4), 2)) };

components.title: Density (drag or click to add)
components.onDrag: return { pts: state.pts.map((x, i) => i === index ? round(pos.x, 2) : x) };
